verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships 'Neo', a built-in AI agent described as taking plain-English infrastructure requests and autonomously handling dependencies, executing changes, and monitoring outcomes, and the MCP docs explicitly note tasks can be delegated to Neo. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of Neo's actual task execution/autonomy (only vendor docs), and detail on scope/guardrails of what Neo can do unsupervised.
